description: Run one meeting-summarizer cycle inline, in the current turn: detect new meeting transcripts, summarize each, file and publish the settled ones, apply any owner answer from the last grouped question, and ask a new grouped question only when a doubt is genuinely open. Use on every scheduled wake of an agent this capability is installed into.

Summarize one meeting or document transcript by hand: classify its type, route it to the right vault folder, fix the filename, and write a structured summary with type-specific or universal prompts. Supports unattended mode and amendment mode (apply an owner answer to an existing summary).
